name: Diagonal wipe
summary: Two-tone diagonal band (colour plus accent) sweeping corner to corner; a dynamic scene change.

params.name: mode
params.note: in covers the frame, out reveals it

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: len
params.note: frames the band takes to cross

params.name: color
params.note: main band colour (accent edge comes from the style)

author: krakujs
